# Favicon Generator

Canonical URL: https://favigen.lowkey.tools/

Source code: https://github.com/shrinathprabhu/favicon-generator

Created by OwlEye Analytics: https://owleye.dev

Developer: Shrinath Prabhu, https://shrinath.me

Follow the maker: https://x.com/shrinath_prabhu

Part of lowkey.tools: https://lowkey.tools

Social preview image: https://favigen.lowkey.tools/og-image.png

Favicon Generator, also called Favigen, is a free developer utility for generating favicon and app icon bundles from one source image. It is designed for apps, websites, and open-source projects that need standard favicon.ico, PNG app icons, platform icons, and web metadata.

## Key facts

- Input: SVG is the primary intended source format.
- Output folder: `<appname>-favicon`.
- Generated favicon files: `favicon.ico`, `favicon.svg`, `original.svg`.
- Generated PNG sizes: `favicon-16x16.png`, `favicon-32x32.png`, `favicon-48x48.png`, `favicon-64x64.png`, `favicon-128x128.png`, `favicon-256x256.png`.
- Generated platform assets: `apple-touch-icon.png`, `android-chrome-192x192.png`, `android-chrome-512x512.png`, `mstile-150x150.png`.
- Generated metadata: `site.webmanifest`, `browserconfig.xml`, `html-tags.txt`.

## OG Image Generator

URL: https://favigen.lowkey.tools/og-image/

- Designs 1200x630 (1.91:1) Open Graph and social share images in the browser, without AI.
- Inputs: title (required), description, eyebrow, brand name, footer, website, and an optional logo or monogram.
- Controls: four layouts (Spotlight, Centered, Split, Editorial), color themes, background styles (solid, gradient, glow, aurora), grid or dot patterns, and any font from Fontsource with weight, size, letter spacing, and line height.
- Exports: PNG, JPG (adjustable quality), or SVG (optionally with embedded fonts).

## Meta Tags

URL: https://favigen.lowkey.tools/meta-tags/

- Fetches a URL (including localhost, through a bookmarklet, pasted HTML, or the local GUI) and reads its title, description, canonical, Open Graph, and X tags.
- Previews the link on Google, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Slack, and updates live while editing.
- Checks title and description length (characters and Google pixel width), image size and aspect ratio, and missing tags.
- Generates HTML meta tags or a Next.js metadata export to paste into a site.

## CLI usage

```sh
npm install
npm run cli -- --input ./logo.svg --app-name "My App"
```

## GUI usage

```sh
npm install
npm run gui
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:5173`.
